主要内容: AbCellera Biologics (NASDAQ: ABCL) saw its stock rise 10.6% in June, driven by positive commentary from its second-quarter earnings report. The company reported $28 million in revenue and a net loss of $0.01 per share, with 138 programs under contract, up 82% year over year. Despite a loss in the current quarter, sales increased by 154.5% year over year. The stock continued to climb in early September as federal officials signaled the potential resumption of bamlanivimab as a treatment for COVID-19. AbCellera's ability to identify the bamlanivimab antibody highlights the value of its platform, and the stock remains a high-risk investment with a market capitalization of around $5.2 billion.
